title: SB124 (2023 Regular): RELATING TO PROHIBITION OF FIREARMS ON SCHOOL PROPERTY.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2023/bills/SB124_.HTM; sha256 04375000bed0f599840c390ad6fc896f8d841dfb4f5774e2e695dd55f69d6e96)
provenance.note: As-filed text (introduced). The school exclusion of a child is a penalty for the bill's own gun rule. Amendments made after the version read are not in the text read.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (new): (a) It shall be unlawful for any person to carry on their person or to possess any firearm: (1) On any school property; (2) On any school bus; or (3) At any school-sponsored function being held at a location that is owned, rented, or leased by the board of education, superintendent of education, department of education, or school for the duration of the function. (b) This section shall not apply to: (1) A law enforcement officer employed by a federal, State, or county law enforcement agency; or (2) A person who serves as an instructor or is a participant in an educational or training program that: (A) Is established, sanctioned, or approved by the board of education, superintendent of education, or department of education; (B) Is held on the school property; and (C) Includes a course of instruction or training that requires the instructor or participant to carry or possess a firearm on the school property or at the school-sponsored function; provided that the exception under this paragraph shall apply only on days on which the person is instructing or participating in a course or training described in subparagraph (c). (c) Any person violating this section shall be guilty of a class B felony. (d) Any child enrolled in a school and found to be in violation of this section shall be excluded from school attendance for not less than one year pursuant to the procedures in section 302A-1134(b).
